title: Telemetry samples
description: A batch of 1 to 25 decoded ring-buffer slots, published by the gateway on plant/{unit_id}/telemetry/samples. The gateway decodes registers into SI numbers and booleans and forwards them; it never interprets a value and adds nothing the simulator did not write.

sample.title: Sample
sample.description: One slot of the simulator's ring buffer, decoded into the tag ids of the signal registry.

seq.description: Sequence number the simulator wrote with the slot. It starts at 1 on every simulator start and wraps at 2^32 - 1.

sim_ts.description: Data time of the slot, taken from the replayed row and never from wall time.

flags.description: The two slot flags of the register model, copied through unchanged.

discontinuity.description: True when data time jumped before this sample, after a gap in the source, a jump or a restart.

missing.description: True when at least one source column of this row could not be parsed; the affected tags keep their previous value.

values.description: One decoded value per tag id of the signal registry: a number for an analog tag, a boolean for a digital one. The synthetic ambient_temperature tag is part of the map like any other.

alarms.description: The controller alarm codes active on this row, expanded from the alarm bits in ascending bit order. Empty when the controller reports none.

samples.description: The samples of one poll batch, ordered by ascending seq. A consumer that sees a gap between batches reads the counters of the gateway status message.

poll.description: What the gateway measured while reading this batch. Optional, for diagnostics only.

poll_seq.description: Number of poll cycles the gateway has completed since it started.

read_ms.description: Milliseconds the register reads of this batch took.
